title: The owner's nine notes: the canyon's pass no longer waits on a queue the crowd gate holds, the shell counts against the drawn body, a small Reed at each nest, the Quiver's second hard core a black, Isao mans the Rotor from the first wave, and THE ARENA's third version (the drive out to a tremor, the player drives phase one, the forced hand-over to the gunship as the mother rises)
context: Owner, 2026-10-16 (late evening), on 11c932b7: '2) quiver, since we one-shot them with the quiver. Let's have one enemy be the purple one, and the second be a Black one, slightly bigger, moves with the 3 appendages, slower, more menacing movement. 3) at the cargo nest that holds the Mortar plans, there are some of those entirely opaque white enemies with hard cores that can damage the tank… what are these? They can also withstand a direct tank shell hit, it goes right through. 4) let's put a small Reed at each cargo spot too. 5) sector 3, the canyon: it fails to unlock and give us the SOL control now. 6) sector 7, canyon again, also not triggering. Announced but not resolving to SOL view. 7) sector 9, the arena is not unlocking either. Let's change it to; a) there's a message to go investigate a different tremor somewhere far… we reach the beacon with the tank… it opens up, phase 1 the player controls the tank as the gunship helps with the reeds (avoid and shoot with shells), then phase 2 the monster is too enormous, cannot allow it to go to the base and wreak havoc, and probably out of tank shells too! Being bait is the only way, we trigger the scene. Now we FORCE the player to take the gunship. Isao quips I am the better driver, I'll lure it. 8) this spot at the far end of the planet is the stage for both the Boss and the Cave.' And earlier: 'The Rotor is not working, and I am tired of troubleshooting it endlessly. let's have Isao set-up the first two towers and they shoot automatically'. Diagnosis of 5 and 6: a headless probe through sectors 2 to 4 laid the canyon's pass two seconds after its queue emptied, which it does there because the frame is cheap; on the owner's machine the crowd gate (CROWD_CAP, by the measured frame) holds part of the 1,500-body column in the queue, which only drains as the base kills the column far away, and the pass (src/fx/sector-run.js tickCanyon) waited on an empty queue. Diagnosis of 7: the seat gate added for the fourteen notes (the gunship within ARENA.seatCells of the arena) was a deadlock: the gunship only flies out once the strip's button is pressed, and the button was only pressed once it was there.
outcome: CANYON.queueWait 10: the pass is laid that many seconds after the first body is up (then seatAfter), queued or not; the rest rise under the beam. The tank shell's direct hit (src/td-tab.js) and the blast (src/domain/shell-blast.js shellHits takes a pointOf; src/fx/shell-blast.js hands groundAt) measure from the body's drawn point. STORY_EXPEDITIONS.sites: each nest's guards gain { family: 'reed', tier: 'small', count: 1 } (src/fx/expedition-glue.js spawns a creature tier in its kit); the owner's opaque white enemies with hard cores at the Mortar nest are the small Reed hunters (HUNTERS.from 2). STORY_QUIVER.second 'phantom' (PEARL_OF black: the biggest tier, three stalks) at secondPace 0.6 (src/domain/story-beats.js). STORY_BEATS.rotorAuto true: the first wave's override calls storyApi.autoTower(rotor) instead of the seat, the brief is rotor_auto, and src/fx/tower-combat.js lets an auto tower fire before the handover and while the player is in another seat; the Quiver stays the player's first seat ('quiver, since we one-shot them with the quiver'). THE ARENA, third version (src/fx/boss-run.js rewritten; ARENA.reachCells 8, waitMax 150, seatWait 45; ARENA_SECTOR without its choice; the brief sends the player to a tremor): phase beacon (the radar's tremor at the arena's cell, the arena's breach held until api.arenaDue: the hull within reachCells, or waitMax, or the harness's arenaNow), phase waves (the hole open: arena_open; the player drives and shoots the small Reeds and the pups; story.gsAuto true so the gunship flies itself over the fight and its track reaches the arena, the call refilled every 5 s off station), phase boss (the Nih-Dairia up: arena_force, the hull on the lure autopilot re-asserted every frame, gsAuto off, the strip's gunship button pressed once the gunship is over the arena or seatWait later; arena_lure at the first shot, boss_hit_me, boss_dead). Lines boss_choice, boss_tank, boss_auto and boss_rises retired (voice list section 16 rewritten, rotor_auto added). Note 8 stands as built: the arena's cell is the farthest reachable and the descent looks at its hole.
alternatives: Lay the canyon's pass on a fixed clock from the sector's start: the hole's first body is the honest start, and queueWait after it keeps the suite's timing.
Keep the choice card and only fix the seat's deadlock: the owner asked for the drive out and the forced hand-over; the card's two picks landed in the same place anyway.
Open the arena's breach at the sector's start and let the player find it: the beacon on the radar and the opening at arrival are the beat he described.
evidence: test/sector-run.mjs (the queue-wait block), test/shell-blast.mjs (the drawn point), test/story-beats.mjs (rotorAuto: the override is autoTower, the Quiver the first seat, the second hard core a phantom at 0.6), test/host-contracts.mjs (57 factories), test/expeditions.mjs
